title: ChatGPT is getting verified AI ‘Business Agents’
slides: Can a chatbot run your business errands?
OpenAI unveils verified AI business agents in ChatGPT
Only approved vendors can deploy them — not anyone
Your team can now delegate bookings and orders
Test one vendor's agent before rivals adopt it
thread_text:
1. Errands, automated?

OpenAI just gave ChatGPT the ability to book and order on your behalf — but only through a shortlist of approved vendors.

2. Approved vendors only

You can't plug in any service you like. Every agent has to pass OpenAI's verification first, which keeps quality tight but options narrow.

3. Delegate the busywork

Your team can now hand off bookings and orders directly inside the chat, cutting the back-and-forth that usually eats a morning.

4. Early access matters

Testing one vendor's agent now means you learn the quirks before competitors do — and you get a say in which workflows get refined.

5. Try it this week

Pick one repetitive task your team does weekly. Test the closest approved agent on it. Does it save time, or just add a review step?
